clue.text: Talking idly of low energy after school

indicators.note: the low-energy stretch comes after the school abbreviation, so school stands first

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do
zing is pep or energy

explanation.surface: Gossip at the school gate about someone running out of steam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low' is the cow's noise, not an adjective meaning feeble.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to chat in an ingratiating, idle way is the slang verb behind this word.

clue.text: Shed tears over heart of city flyer

indicators.note: in a down clue, over signals the word for crying is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: to shed tears is to weep

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle letters

explanation.surface: Someone weeps over the loss of a city bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses WEEP to PEEW; 'heart of' takes IT from the middle of 'city'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: this is another name for the lapwing, a bird and hence a flyer.

clue.text: Concentrates, seeing German town's protecting church

indicators.note: the town's name wraps round the church abbreviation like a guard around it

parts.note: Essen is a city in Germany's Ruhr; with the 's it gives ESSENS
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A traveller sees a German town sheltering its church and concentrates on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Concentrates' is a plural noun here, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: extracts or distilled forms of a substance are its concentrates.

clue.text: Come out — father's climbing tree!

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the word for father is read upwards

parts.note: PA is father; the 's is read as 'is' linking it on
a pear is a fruit tree

explanation.surface: A child calls dad to come down after he has climbed a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to come out into view is to become visible, show up.

clue.text: Almost consider covering lesson, having lost social standing

indicators.note: the shortened word for consider wraps round the lesson
almost means the word for consider loses its final letter

parts.note: to deem is to consider
a class is a lesson

explanation.surface: A teacher covering a lesson feels their status has slipped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' reads like a substitute teacher's job, but it puts the trimmed word around the lesson, leaving DEE split either side.
explanation.definitionFit: Borrowed French: someone fallen in rank or status in society is described this way.

clue.text: Answer found in favourite fuel

indicators.note: the answer abbreviation is found inside the word for favourite

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: A quiz answer turns out to be someone's favourite fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: dried bog turf is burned as a fuel, especially in Ireland.

clue.text: Studies should encompass one case of cook becoming author

indicators.note: the word for studies must surround the next pieces

parts.note: dens are studies, private rooms for work
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside letters

explanation.surface: A cook turned writer, studying a single recipe case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' is not a container here: the outside letters of 'cook' are its case.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Victorian novelist who wrote Oliver Twist and Great Expectations.

clue.text: Rows caused by fixing resident's game

indicators.note: fixing a game rigs it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Quarrels break out because a local has rigged the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rows' rhymes with cows here: arguments, not lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: quarrels or arguments are rows in British usage.

clue.text: See 13
Trustees reach out, finding valuable hidden store

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Trustees reach out and discover a hidden hoard of value.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a box of buried gold and jewels is the classic secret hoard of riches.

clue.text: Unknown location that sees an amount of sport, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the words are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: an amount is a sum, and to sport clothes is to wear them: SUM WEAR

explanation.surface: A sports venue reported to see plenty of action, location unspecified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sport' is the verb meaning to wear, not athletics.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an unspecified or unknown place is described as being at some spot.

clue.text: Special attention needed to hold hot drink

indicators.note: the two words together hold the answer inside them, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: A barista gives special care to a hot drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an Italian-style coffee made with steamed milk is a hot drink.

clue.text: Suggestion from good crowd?

parts.note: a host is a large crowd or multitude

explanation.surface: A proposal put forward by a well-meaning crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suggestion' is a faint trace, as in 'the ghost of a smile'.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a faint trace or slight hint, as in the phrase about a smile.

clue.text: Manchester's strip redesigned for 12?

indicators.note: a redesigned kit means its letters are reworked into new order

explanation.surface: Manchester's football kit gets a new look for the season.
explanation.walkthrough: Clue 12 is GHOST: Dickens's A Christmas Carol has the Ghost of Christmas Present.
explanation.definitionFit: Literary reference: Dickens's spirit visiting Scrooge on the holiday itself is named after the present festive day.

clue.text: Note — editor accepts second game is not given fair opposition

indicators.note: the editor takes on the earlier pieces, attaching itself at the end

parts.note: mi is a note of the sol-fa scale
a match is a game

explanation.surface: An editor's note complains that a second game was unfair.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a contest between badly unequal sides leaves one side without fair opposition.

clue.text: Stay around, with son after the French food

indicators.note: son is placed after the French article
around signals the word for stay is turned round

parts.note: to bide is to stay
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A family stays on for a French meal with their son.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: things fit to eat, foodstuffs, are referred to collectively by this plural noun.

clue.text: Time a proposal might generate a jumpy listener?

parts.note: leapy is a playful coinage for jumpy, given to leaping
an ear is the organ that listens

explanation.surface: A marriage proposal could produce a startled listener.
explanation.walkthrough: By tradition a woman may propose marriage on 29 February.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradition: the year with 29 February, when women may propose, is when a proposal might come.

clue.text: Doctor sees new right for worker in theatre

indicators.note: new signals the word sees is made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A doctor sees a new rightward shift in an operating-theatre worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' suggests surgery, but this is a stage costume assistant. 'new' rearranges SEES to ESSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: backstage, the person who helps actors into costume is a theatre worker.

clue.text: Short shift should include merry tune for such a set

indicators.note: the shortened dress must hold the next piece within it
short means the word for shift loses its last letter

parts.note: a shift is a simple straight dress

indicators.note: merry suggests a tipsy jumble, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A short work shift includes a cheerful tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shift' looks like a work period but is the straight dress; 'merry' jumbles the tune, and that goes in after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a set of false teeth is a set of this kind, the dentist's set.

clue.text: Russian aircraft helping mass movement

parts.note: the MiG is a Russian fighter jet
a ration is a portion or helping

explanation.surface: Soviet jets assisting a large population shift.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: seasonal journeys of birds or herds are large-scale movements.

clue.text: Resistant setter's married a Parisienne!

parts.note: the setter speaks as I; setter's means I am, IM
une is French for a, feminine, as a Parisienne would say

explanation.surface: The setter boasts of having married a woman from Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: protected against infection or influence means resistant to it.

clue.text: Staff ran campaign to keep old currency

indicators.note: the words keep the answer within them, across the word breaks

explanation.surface: Staff run a campaign to keep an old currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: France's money before the euro, a now-defunct currency.

clue.text: 13 yet to pass 12?

parts.note: Christmas yet to come, the third spirit in Dickens's Carol; the ghost yet to pass is the one still ahead

explanation.surface: A Christmas spirit still waiting to arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 is CHRISTMAS, 12 GHOST: the Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come shows what is to come.
explanation.definitionFit: Reference: the time still to come is what Dickens's last spirit reveals to Scrooge.

clue.text: One double parking in New York needs to be quick

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the abbreviation for New York

parts.note: NY is New York
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: double means the parking letter is written twice

explanation.surface: Someone double-parked in New York has to move fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in British informal usage, nifty or speedy means quick.

clue.text: 13 over 12?

parts.note: when Christmas is over it is behind us; Dickens's first spirit is that of Christmas gone by

explanation.surface: A spirit appearing once the festive season has ended.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 is CHRISTMAS, 12 GHOST: the Ghost of Christmas Past is the first of the three spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Reference: time gone by, over and done, names the first spirit visiting Scrooge.

clue.text: Jerry perhaps welcomes return of Tom with hot feature

indicators.note: the mouse takes in the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: Jerry of Tom and Jerry is a mouse

indicators.note: return signals the word for Tom is read backwards

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: In the cartoon, Jerry welcomes Tom back with a hot facial feature.
explanation.walkthrough: Tom and Jerry are the cartoon cat and mouse, so each name stands for its animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a growth of hair on the upper lip is a facial feature.

clue.text: Experience open-top bus in colour

indicators.note: the shortened bus goes in the word for colour

parts.note: a stain is a colouring or dye

indicators.note: an open-top bus has lost its top, its first letter

explanation.surface: Tourists experience an open-top bus tour in colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to undergo or suffer, as in a loss or injury, is to experience it.

clue.text: Bring in different set, getting serious

parts.note: to bring in money is to earn

indicators.note: different means the letters of set take another order

explanation.surface: Bringing in a different set to make things serious.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sincere and solemn, not joking, means serious.
